jobs.title: Senior Frontend Engineer
jobs.content:
Example Co is a fully remote company building analytics tooling for research teams across Europe. We are hiring a Senior Frontend Engineer to own the charting and query-builder surfaces of our product.

What you will do

  • Ship product surfaces in TypeScript and React, from problem framing through rollout
  • Own the design system and the accessibility baseline across the app
  • Work directly with product and design, not through a ticket queue
  • Improve frontend performance budgets and the metrics behind them

What we look for

  • Several years building production frontends in TypeScript and React
  • Comfort with testing, CI, and owning what you ship
  • Written communication that works across time zones

Working here

Remote-first, EMEA time zones. We hire employees in a handful of countries and contract with EU-registered entities everywhere else. Salary band for this role is EUR 85,000 to 110,000 depending on level.

jobs.title: Product Engineer, Growth
jobs.content:
Join the growth pod as a Product Engineer. You will run experiments end to end: build the surface, instrument it, read the result, and decide what happens next.

  • TypeScript, React, and a Python backend you are welcome to touch
  • Own onboarding, activation, and the pricing page
  • Small team, direct access to the data

Fully remote within EMEA. We are happy to work with contractors holding an EU-registered company. Range: EUR 80,000 to 100,000.

jobs.title: Engineering Manager, Platform
jobs.content:
We are looking for an Engineering Manager to lead the platform team of six engineers. This is a people-leadership role: hiring, growth, and delivery, with roughly a day a week of hands-on work.

  • Line-manage six engineers across three time zones
  • Own the platform roadmap with the head of engineering
  • Run performance and compensation cycles

Remote within Europe.

jobs.title: Frontend Engineer
jobs.content:
Frontend Engineer for our New York office. This role is hybrid: three days a week on site in Manhattan, two days from home. US work authorization required; we do not sponsor visas for this position.

  • React and TypeScript across the customer-facing app
  • Close collaboration with the New York design team
